fusions.name: Raw Aria
fusions.desc: A thrown note of raw arcana that deals 5 damage, hitting harder the further it travels, up to 1.8 times at maximum range. Its reach is 40% longer.

fusions.name: Overflowing Crescendo
fusions.desc: Sends a swelling crescendo that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets and bursts, dealing 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Stilled Sea
fusions.desc: Sings every creature within 5 tiles still for 4 seconds. They cannot be healed while it holds.

fusions.name: Building Hum
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
